ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope and scale of Medicaid fraud, and explore ways to prevent and detect it.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
How can we prevent and detect Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: Medicaid fraud is a complex and ongoing issue, and this story would provide a comprehensive look at the problem and potential solutions.
